institution: University of North Carolina at Greensboro

app_fee.value: The Graduate School charges a $65 nonrefundable application processing fee.

fee_waiver.value: The fee is waived only for a short list of UNCG employees, certain scholarship or program participants, and military; no general international waiver is listed.
fee_waiver.quote: the application fee is not required for full-time UNCG employees (excludes student employees), McNair Scholars

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no single GRE rule; each program decides, so see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Official results of GRE scores or other examinations as required by the program to which one applies

toefl_min.value: The page's TOEFL figure reads only '4', which is not a usable minimum, so no score is recorded.

ielts_min.value: Graduate applicants need an IELTS band score of 6.5.

english_waiver.value: A degree from a non-US university where English is the primary language of instruction waives the English test. The page does not name India, so check that the degree is taught mainly in English.
english_waiver.quote: The applicant is or will be a graduate of a non-U.S. college/university where English is the primary language of instruction

notes: Graduate English proficiency scores must be no more than 2 years old at application. Other exemptions include INTERLINK Level 6 and graduates of US regionally accredited universities.
